key_assumptions.input: Starting free cash flow per share
key_assumptions.source: FY2025 cash from operating activities $28.6M divided by 127.7M basic shares (20-F FY2025 consolidated cash flow); excludes treasury fair-value volatility in net loss

FY2025 reported net loss $785.5M driven by fair value losses on digital assets held ($675M), finance expense on related-party debt, and admin including share-based comp. Lawrence base uses filing OCF $28.6M as owner cash proxy, not GAAP net income or crypto treasury marks.
Exchange spread plus CoinDesk indices/data grow with institutional crypto adoption; OCF normalized off FY2025

thesis: Bullish Global Limited operates an institutional-focused digital asset exchange (Bullish Exchange) and owns CoinDesk, a crypto media, indices, data, and events platform. **[Fact]** The Bullish Exchange runs a global central limit order book with automated market making, spot and derivatives products, and portfolio margin. **[Fact]** CoinDesk spans Indices (CoinDesk 20 and benchmarks), Data (270k+ trading pairs), Insights (Coindesk.com, Consensus events), and related subscription and licensing revenue. **[Fact]** FY2025 digital asset sales (gross customer turnover passed through the exchange) were **$244.8 billion**; gross spread after cost of digital assets derecognized was about **$78 million**. **[Fact]** Other revenues (CoinDesk, fees, subscriptions, liquidity services) were **$158.9 million** in FY2025. **[Fact]** The company reported a FY2025 net loss of **$785.5 million** and cash from operations of **$28.6 million** on **127.7 million** basic shares. **[Fact]** Cash was **$87.9 million** at year-end 2025; borrowings due to a related-party SPV were **$514.8 million**. **[Fact]** Customer digital assets safeguarded were **$117.6 million** at December 31, 2024 per filing XBRL tags.
why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** complexity discount (pass-through turnover masks thin spread economics; treasury and related-party capital structure obscure operating cash).
